question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "launched."**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "launched" **accurately describes the action of sending the Soviet Sputnik into space.
 
• **"Launched"** means to start something new or to show something for the first time. (कोई नया काम शुरू करना या किसी वस्‍तु को पहली बार प्रदर्शित करना)
 
• In the context of space exploration,** "launched"** specifically denotes the act of propelling a spacecraft or satellite from Earth into space. 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is** Option 2.**
 
• **Correct paragraph:**

**​**Any object__ that revolves around a planet is a satellite. Mother Earth has a natural satellite in the moon. The earth is circled by a lot of man-made or artificial satellites. In 1957, the Soviet Sputnik was the first to be __**launched**__ into space. There are currently a number of artificial satellites launched into space by various nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Lobbed: **to hit, kick or throw a ball high into the air, so that it lands behind your opponent. (गेंद को ऐसे ऊपर मारना या फेंकना कि वह प्रतिपक्षी खिलाड़ी के पीछे गिरे)
 
• **Floated: **to move slowly through air or water. (हवा या पानी में तिरना, बहना, उतराना)
 
• **Tossed: **to throw something lightly and carelessly. (किसी वस्‍तु को हलके से और लापरवाही से फेंकना, उछालना)
